$comment: Generic rules shipped with the operating-model plugin. A project adds its own, or disables one of these by id, in <project>/.claude/guard-rules.json. Format: README.md beside this file.

rules.message: `gh pr merge --auto` is refused: in a repository whose default branch has no required status checks, --auto merges at once, before CI finishes. Safe form: watch the checks (`gh pr checks <pr> --watch`), then merge explicitly (`gh pr merge <pr> --squash`). A project that does require checks can turn this rule off in .claude/guard-rules.json.

`bao token lookup` and `vault token lookup`, and a `lookup-self` read without a `-field=` other than `id`, are refused: they print the token itself. Safe form: read one field, for example `bao read -field=ttl auth/token/lookup-self` (other fields: policies, display_name, expire_time).
